validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "user"
WHERE email = 'susan.garcia@servicenow.com'
  AND active = 0;

name: Case CS-0000001 now owned by Stephanie in CSM Tier 1 with Critical priority
description: Case CS-0000001 now owned by Stephanie in CSM Tier 1 with Critical priority

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN "user" u ON cc.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON cc.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE cc.number = 'CS-0000001'
  AND u.email = 'stephanie.todd@servicenow.com'
  AND g.name = 'CSM Tier 1 Support'
  AND cc.priority = 'critical';

name: Stephanie has no other group memberships
description: Stephanie has no other group memberships

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM user_group_member gm
JOIN "user" u ON gm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.email = 'stephanie.todd@servicenow.com'
  AND g.name <> 'CSM Tier 1 Support';
